blocks.content:
• NITI Aayog is NOT a constitutional body.
• It was formed in 2015.
• Prime Minister is the Chairperson.
• It does NOT allocate funds.
• Replaced Planning Commission.
NITI Aayog is NOT a constitutional body.

rows: Allocated funds to states and ministries

items: Exam Trap: Options often falsely claim NITI Aayog is a constitutional or statutory body.
Fund Allocation: Remember that NITI Aayog does NOT allocate funds, a key difference often tested in MCQs.
Direct Question: NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 1 January 2015 under the Chairmanship of the Prime Minister.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: NITI Aayog was established in 2015 to replace the Planning Commission.
It is a non-constitutional body created via an executive resolution.
The Prime Minister of India serves as the Chairperson of NITI Aayog.
Unlike the Planning Commission, NITI Aayog has no mandate or power to allocate funds.
